title: 第15章 执念

content_zh:
洞府约三丈左右，角落处摆放着一张石床，占了小半个空间。石床跟前是一个石盒，宽半米，长能有一米，有一种古朴的味道，里面装满了鹅卵石般大的晶块，晶莹剔透，闪闪发光。
“这个洞我很早以前就发现了，每次爹爹前来，我都想告诉他，可是他来得快去得快，看我一眼就走了，没有机会说。”
无天安慰道：“你爹爹肯定有什么重要的事情要做，不能停留太久。”
“无天哥哥，你怎么知道？爹爹每次也这样说，可是我真的很想他多留几天。”诗诗小脸扬起，粉嫩嫩的，带有一丝失落。
“因为每个人都有事要做，你不是也要照顾小花吗？”揉了揉小丫头的小脑袋，无天安慰道，然后走到石盒前，拾起一枚晶块，仔细的看着，眉头渐渐皱了起来。
晶块有棱有角，宛如钻石般，光华迷人。忽然，一股热流从晶块溢出，涌进手心，汇聚到气海。
“精元。”无天惊讶，这热流给他的感觉，与小天提炼的精元一模一样，甚至更加精纯，如浩海般磅礴。
他放下精元，踩了踩地面，地上很充实，非常坚硬。而后，若有所思的走向石壁，上面很平整，没有一丝裂痕，他伸手去摸，一层石灰掉落。
无天环顾四周，眼里有了明悟。
这个洞府很奇怪，像是在一块巨石中，硬生生凿开一个空间。他怀疑这可能是一个古人修炼的洞府，因为这是一种名叫铁岩的石头，这种石头比黑铁还要坚硬，若要有风化的齑粉，最低都要千年之久。
“诗诗，你发现这里的时候，还有没有其他东西。”无天问道。
诗诗托腮想了一阵，道：“好像有一具白骨，我看他挺可怜的，就埋在外面了。”
“看来真是这样。”
无天非常好奇，仔细打量着每个角落，千年前的古人，修炼的洞府，肯定不会只有这些精元，说不定还会留下什么异宝。
小天早已经乐呵呵，它跳到精元上，左看看，右看看，唾液横飞，最后它躺在上面，翘着二郎腿，眼中有小星星在打转，同时警惕的扫着小依，显然它要据为己有。
原来它不止贪吃，还贪财！
小依翻白眼，雪白的头颅高扬，非常不屑，那意思是，你拿去好了，这些破珠子我根本看不上眼。
“无天哥哥，你在找什么。”诗诗奇怪看着他转来转去，疑惑道。
“找宝贝。”无天头也不回，这边敲敲，那边看看，不放过每寸地方。
“嘻嘻！”诗诗笑的很开心，道：“这里是死人洞府，能有什么好东西呀！”

“呃！不见得哟，这些精元就是好东西，只是你不懂，我看肯定还有其他的物品。”无天脸不红，想发死人财，他走到石床前，爬了下去，伸手在床下胡乱摸。
“嗯？好像找到了。”在石床下，他摸到了一个硬邦邦的东西，有些冰冷：“诗诗，借你光用下。”
诗诗好奇的跑了过去，趴在地上，将手伸进床下，里面被照的通亮，能看得一清二楚。
“咦，真的有东西耶！”诗诗惊讶，想去取出，可发现手不够长。
“小家伙，快过来帮忙。”无天手也够不着，叫小天帮忙。
听说有宝贝，小家伙屁颠屁颠跑了过来，狭长的眸子瞅了瞅，顿时冒光，兴奋的跑了进去，但出来时，却一副兴趣缺缺的样子，扔下东西，便跳回石盒上。
这一枚很普通的戒指，黑漆漆的，非常古老，表层有脱落的痕迹，没有其他装饰，却刻印着三个微小的字，扭扭曲曲，难以分辨。
“这戒指好丑。”诗诗瘪了瘪嘴，爱美是女人的天性，小丫头也不例外。
拿着戒指瞧了半响，无天也瞧不出所以然来，心里有些失望，本以为是什么宝贝，结果只是一个平常之物。他不甘心，又找了片刻，但什么也没发现，他放弃了。
也许这个洞府的主人，并没有多强，所以珍贵的东西不多，随手将戒指放进怀里，无天开始行动了起来。
宝物虽没有，但这些精元也不差，存在千年之久，精气还如此旺盛，精纯而又浓厚，若全都炼化吸收，定能突破更高一层。
“呱呱…”小家伙不依，死死的趴在上面，张牙舞爪，那意思是，这是我的，不准拿。
“小东西快放手，不可以和哥哥抢。”诗诗被逗得咯咯直笑，上前劝导，但小家伙油盐不进，像是一个小财奴，守护私有财产，打死不同意。

content_en:
The cave is about three feet long, with a stone bed placed in the corner, occupying a small half of the space. In front of the stone bed is a stone box, half a meter wide and one meter long. It has a simple taste and is filled with crystal blocks as big as pebbles, crystal clear and sparkling.
"I discovered this hole a long time ago. Every time my father comes, I want to tell him, but he leaves as quickly as he comes. He takes one look at me and leaves without a chance to tell me."
Wutian comforted him: "Your father must have something important to do, so he can't stay too long."
"Brother Wutian, how do you know? Daddy says this every time, but I really want him to stay a few more days." Shishi's little face raised, pink and tender, with a hint of disappointment.
"Because everyone has something to do, don't you also have to take care of Xiaohua?" Wutian comforted the little girl after rubbing her little head, then walked to the stone box, picked up a crystal nugget, looked at it carefully, and frowned gradually.
The crystal blocks have edges and corners, like diamonds, with charming brilliance. Suddenly, a stream of heat overflowed from the crystal block, poured into the palm of his hand, and gathered into the sea of ​​​​qi.
"Jingyuan." Wutian was surprised. The feeling given by this heat flow was exactly the same as the essence refined by Xiaotian, even purer, as majestic as the vast ocean.
He put down the essence and stepped on the ground. The ground was full and very hard. Then, he walked thoughtfully towards the stone wall. It was very smooth without any cracks. He stretched out his hand to touch it, and a layer of lime fell off.
Wutian looked around, with enlightenment in his eyes.
This cave is very strange, like a space carved out of a huge rock. He suspected that this might be a cave where ancient people practiced, because it was a kind of stone called iron rock, which was harder than black iron. If there was weathered powder, it would have to be at least a thousand years old.
"Shishi, when you found this place, was there anything else?" Wutian asked.
Shishi held her chin and thought for a while, then said: "It seems there is a white skeleton. I think he is quite pitiful, so he buried it outside."
"It seems so."
Wutian was very curious and looked at every corner carefully. The caves where the ancients practiced thousands of years ago would definitely not only have these essences, but they might also leave some rare treasures.
Xiaotian was already very happy. It jumped on Jingyuan, looked left and right, and saliva flew everywhere. Finally, it lay on it, with its legs crossed, and little stars were spinning in its eyes. At the same time, it glanced at Xiaoyi warily, obviously it wanted to take it for itself.
It turns out that it is not only greedy, but also greedy for money!
Xiaoyi rolled her eyes, her snow-white head raised high, and she was very disdainful. That means, just take it, I don't like these broken beads at all.
"Brother Wutian, what are you looking for?" Shishi looked at him strangely and asked in confusion.
"Looking for the treasure." Wutian didn't look back, knocking here and looking there, not missing every inch.
"Hehe!" Shishi smiled happily and said, "This is the Cave of the Dead, what good things can there be!"
"Uh! Not necessarily. These essences are good things, but you don't understand. I think there must be other items." Wutian blushed and wanted to make a fortune. He walked to the stone bed, climbed down, and reached out to touch randomly under the bed.
"Huh? I think I found it." Under the stone bed, he touched a hard object, which was a little cold: "Shishi, I'll lend it to you."
Shishi ran over curiously, lay down on the ground, and reached under the bed. The inside was brightly lit and she could see clearly.
"Hey, there really is something!" Shishi was surprised and wanted to take it out, but found that her hands were not long enough.
"Little guy, come here and help." Wutian couldn't reach it with his hands, so he asked Xiaotian to help.
Hearing that there was a treasure, the little guy ran over, took a look, his narrow eyes suddenly lit up, and he ran in excitedly, but when he came out, he looked uninterested, dropped the things, and jumped back on the stone box.
This is a very ordinary ring, blackIt is lacquered and very old, with signs of peeling off the surface. There are no other decorations, but three tiny characters are engraved on it, which are twisted and difficult to distinguish.
"This ring is so ugly." Shishi pursed her lips. It is a woman's nature to love beauty, and little girls are no exception.
After holding the ring and looking at it for a long time, Wutian couldn't figure out why. He felt a little disappointed. He thought it was some kind of treasure, but it turned out to be just an ordinary thing. Unwilling to give up, he searched for a moment more, but found nothing, so he gave up.
Maybe the owner of this cave wasn't very powerful, so he didn't have many precious things. He casually put the ring into his arms, and Wutian started to take action.
Although there are no treasures, these essences are not bad. They have existed for thousands of years, and the essences are still so strong, pure and thick. If they are all refined and absorbed, they will definitely be able to break through to a higher level.
"Quack..." The little guy refused and lay on it, showing his teeth and claws. That meant that this was mine and he was not allowed to take it.
"Little thing, let go quickly, don't snatch it from your brother." Shishi was so amused that she giggled and stepped forward to persuade him, but the little guy was indifferent, like a little miser, guarding private property, and he refused to agree.
